'''''Baobab Archives Compendiums''''' were a cultural etiquette manual, distributed on specialized [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]], that [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] had consulted whenever a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] was unavailable or a situation proved too specialized. Packed with detailed customs for each culture, the compendiums had guided [[Emissary/Legends|emissaries]] in selecting appropriate gifts, avoiding accidental insults, and preparing talking points before meetings—or during convenient pauses—so they could navigate foreign societies without embarrassing missteps.<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
